spans.text: ...In the streets.
The Griffin entourage is moving through the streets in careful formation.
Other than the Infected who are oblivious to their own tragic fate, the battlefield is littered with broken bodies.
RO635 guns down another batch of ELIDs, then notices something all of a sudden.
(A blue signal ID...)
(A Griffin Doll that's unaccounted for?)

RO635 gestures at her teammate to keep quiet and stay close, then she moves cautiously to a pile of rubble. Behind a metal panel sprinkled with bullet holes, she finds a distraught Doll, clutching at her chest and shivering uncontrollably.
Before her lies the remains of an Infected blasted beyond recognition.
Are...you okay?
The gray-haired Doll doesn't reply.
Are you a Griffin Doll?
Are you part of the surveillance team that we lost contact with...? We have some new recruits on this operation... You're HS2000, aren't you? I've read your file.
The girl lifts her head, showing a face full of fear...and shame.
I'm sorry... I-I'm so scared...
He... That man...
...Where are your teammates?
They...for me... I'm...I'm sorry... I was too scared...
I didn't know how to respond to the situation... My neural cloud was completely blank... I couldn't move...
Calm down. Look at me.
If I could fight properly, my teammates wouldn't have...
But...I'm just a Medical Doll...
I didn't see so many dead bodies on my first mission - I was a lot luckier than you.
Which is why you, whose first mission is to repel ELIDs on the battlefield, are so much braver.
But...I...
You're facing enemies that shouldn't have been yours to face - this courage alone is commendable.
So stop blaming yourself. What matters now is to survive.
HS2000 looks up. Beyond her initial panic, RO635 now sees a glint of surprise and gratitude in her eyes.
I suppose you don't want to suddenly find yourself back at the base in a brand spanking new body with no memory of what has happened before, right?
I...don't want that...
RO635 looks around vigilantly and taps HS2000 gently on the shoulder.
Then try not to get hit. Just survive for now, okay?
Now that you've rejoined our main force, let's all do our best to go home without a scratch.
With a wavering gleam in her eyes, HS2000 finally nods at RO635.
She gets on her feet unsteadily and jogs over to the group of Griffin Dolls.
RO635 gets up and walks away once she's made sure the Doll has settled in.
If I could help it, I really wouldn't want these girls to experience something so cruel.
